reader_notes: Option D is a good over-reach trap: Steinvik explicitly declines to call the patterns decorative, so 'no bearing' fails on a careful read.
Option A plays on the depth discussion but reverses what is licensed (only that a 12-micron-shallower dimple behaves like none, not a deeper-is-longer rule).
Crisp, natural science-journalism English; the 332/392 sleeve detail is a nice authentic touch.
